reviews.title: What a fantastic app!
reviews.text: This app became essential for me. I quit 6 years ago but I still come back to see my days and money I’ve not spent on smoking.

reviews.title: Good start
reviews.text: This is the first time I’ve ever used an app to help me quit smoking. I am using the Free version it’s helping somewhat. This has been the most challenging quit attempt I’ve ever had but I would say is do not wait in your life because what it’s doing to your brain, you have no idea and I didn’t realize that either until I started researching more and the research that I found said to try and use some online support system so I am trying this. I may get the paid version moving forward. I like the fact that it’s calculating the money I’m saving.

reviews.title: Helped me so much
reviews.text: Keeping track and staying current without shame has helped so much..,this is my second time quitting and it helped so much the first time and is doing great this time as well…I love knowing what I’m gaining back each day as encouragement to stay off…it’s been wonderful

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: I joined a stop smoking sub on Reddit and found this app. It is a great tool to track my quitting journey. So many others have requested it and also find it helpful

reviews.title: Will not verify email
reviews.text: You must verify your email address in order to use the app. I tried 5 times, but it kept saying “Open the email on the same device as you installed the app and follow the instructions in the email”. I WAS. Pretty frustrating.

reviews.title: The sharpest tool in my shed
reviews.text: Being a successful quitter requires multiple resources to drop upon along the journey. This app has been one of my best resources for support, reassurance, and progress.

reviews.title: After 20 years, I quit
reviews.text: This app has been really helpful. Having such quantifiable data was really motivating and helped keep me from slipping up.  I stuck it and have been smoke free for 533 days as of this review!

reviews.title: This app is heaven
reviews.text: So detailed and goal oriented I love this app. Thank you so much

reviews.title: Highly recommend app
reviews.text: I’ve been a non-smoker since September 2020 thanks to this app.  Tried to quit many times before but going cold turkey, while temporarily eliminating stimulants (caffeine and sugar) and using this app finally did the trick. I was a long term pack a day smoker.

reviews.title: Lost data
reviews.text: Wasn’t using sign in, new update removed that as an option no forewarning, removed my info and reset everything lost my timer. Deleting

reviews.title: Inner Dragon
reviews.text: I love the way the counter has days for example 8 days not 1 week 1 day.  I wish there was an hours feature there’s something about “ 193” hours that’s cool too.  I love the dragon growing and the games.  It’s been a super incentive and fun!

reviews.title: Broken From Start
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and inserted my email and couldn’t even get the verification email. I tried three times following the instructions and still no email. So are we just making fishing apps now to fraudulently steal people’s email/info? What’s the play here?

reviews.title: Best app for quitting
reviews.text: It shows you how much money you give to the cigarette companies and how your health is affected

reviews.title: Just data collection
reviews.text: Blatantly obvious this app is just collecting data. Why would you need to create an account for something as simple as tracking days without smoking? They claim “It’s so you can recover your account.” I don’t need an account. I need a SIMPLE DAY COUNTER.

reviews.title: Really helping
reviews.text: This app is incredibly well-thought out. It is very user-friendly & the developer seems to have listened to users. My favorite part is the daily "Missions" - things to do to help with cravings & to prepare for obstacles. I also like the diary feature. I'm on day 7, smoke-free & this app has helped A LOT!!! Thank you.

reviews.title: Helps
reviews.text: This really helped me stay motivated and on track with quitting smoking! I smoked for 20 years and I can say I’ve quit

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.text: I like being able to see how long it has been since I last smoked. Also, the health improvement section is terrific.

reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.text: Best

reviews.title: It shouldn’t be this hard to update and delete
reviews.text: I caved and wanted to be honest about it, so I went in to change my date but it wouldn’t let me.  It kept freezing.  Finally, I got so frustrated (and, ironically, just wanted to smoke more) that I looked for a way to delete it and, as it turns out, there’s no actual way to do it in the app.  Maybe there was once, but now you have to e-mail them and make a formal request to delete your account.  It shouldn’t be this hard to update or delete your account.  Makes one feel trapped.  From what I can tell, all the smoking apps suck.  I’ve only ever liked one but, unfortunately, it no longer exists.  Forget it.  I’ll just keep track of it myself.  Thanks for nothing, Silicon Valley.

reviews.title: accountability
reviews.text: this app is great. It lets you come back time and time again. If you need to it doesn’t overwhelm you with notifications the notifications slow down. If you don’t check in, they don’t get more antagonizing. it’s worth every penny.

reviews.title: bouttabust
reviews.text: helpful app. it’s nice to have my days tracked and crazy to be able to see all the ways the bad habit damaged me and how that damage is being repaired over time. 10/10

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: I have been struggling with smoking and I quit using ten years ago and NA helped. This is kind of like that. A community of people going through the same thing, recognising achievements, and all the extra features. I can not recommend this app enough to those who are quitting. Ten bucks for a lifetime membership isn’t bad. I do believe it is worth it

reviews.title: Supportive
reviews.text: This is a great app, full of support from other members and the app is easy to navigate.  I highly recommend!

reviews.title: Quit Now!
reviews.text:
This app was super helpful for me. Especially the tally of cigarettes I would have smoked at any certain point. It was alarming to see it broke down like that and a big incentive to stop for good.
Been 5 days and going strong!

reviews.title: Лучший трекер
reviews.text: Решила бросить курить, скачала все возможные трекеры для отслеживание прогресса и мотивации. Этот самый лучший и информативный даже в бесплатной версии. Еще и ачивки есть! Не курю уже больше недели)

reviews.title: AVOID REQUIRES EMAIL SIGNUP
reviews.text: Steals information and tracks you

reviews.title: Perfect App
reviews.text: Really Helpful Tool that tracks the time you’ve quit, the money you’ve saved and the health benefits you’ve reaped. You have the choice to use it to access support if you choose to do so. I gave up smoking 1 year, 3 months and 13 days ago and saved $4734.30. I know this because I still visit the app from time to time! Highly recommended app!

reviews.title: Keep Checking Back
reviews.text: Love that I can always go back and see my progress. 5 months in it still helps some days to see how far I have come.

reviews.title: Doing it for good
reviews.text: Before I downloaded this app, I read, or listened to, Allen Carr’s Easy Way. Highly recommend. Listening to this book helped to set a foundation for me holding myself accountable this time. The day before I was due to stop, I downloaded the app and “explored” everything. Having missions to look forward to and accomplish, helps. The app also gives me something to do while keeping my mindset on track with quitting. This is totally possible. Once one can understand just how much benefit (none) smoking brings a person, your mindset about smoking will start to change. It’s not easy, but I’m also finding this time to be easier than the last several times. I’ve got support, I’ve got resources and I get daily “pats on the back” for sticking to it.

reviews.title: Great app! Very helpful
reviews.text: Thanks for providing a great app and service to help people like me overcome the challenges of quitting smoking. I appreciate that the app has a lot of features at the free level and doesn’t force me to subscribe. However I would see a benefit in doing so if I could afford a subscription.

reviews.title: Helpful app
reviews.text: The app is a helpful tool if you Lao have your mind set for the most part. It helps keep you accountable. Everyday it helps you see how far you’ve come in many areas. I enjoy opening the app everyday I wake up and seeing how far I’ve finally come. I highly recommend this app if you’re quitting smoking.

reviews.title: Money money money
reviews.text: Love seeing it and feeling great

reviews.title: A lot of the features feel half baked/non-functional
reviews.text:
I don’t *actually* care about the Inner Dragon thing beyond engaging with it as a joke, but there doesn’t seem to be a way to increase the energy stat? Has just dropped to 0 and stayed there no matter what I do. 

Unless it’s tied to the mushroom memory game, but that game honestly isn’t fun and takes way too long.

reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: Love using this app to help keep me motivated and proud of myself, even with the “set backs.”

reviews.title: pointless give both options
reviews.text: another app only to help cigarette smokers stop, not vaping.

reviews.title: Not worth any money
reviews.text: Yeah it’s cool, but it’s not worth a cent.

reviews.title: It Helped
reviews.text: When the cravings were bad I’d open the app to see in real time how long it’s been since my Last Last Cigarette. Not wanting to waste that time and being able to see down to the second truly helped.

reviews.title: Free, authentic, and real
reviews.text: Best smoking app I know. There are two free + awesome aspects of the app: global-connect wall of fame &  the (worldwide?) community thread where you can post about cravings publicly.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: Couldn’t do it without the support of others all around the world. Feels like Facebook but for smokers.

reviews.title: Amazing App
reviews.text:
Great companion for the Quit journey, it really motivates you.
Technically the app is highly functional and lots of ways to find help with cravings while remaining easy to use.
Thanks

reviews.title: A very helpful reminder
reviews.text: I’ve made several attempts and have been successful a few times. spanning a few months. Then life struggles hit… smoking cause more harm and zero benefit, ZERO! Even makes your wallet hit zero at nearly $14 a pack depending where you live. Now is the time! Allow this great app to guide you, to remind you that now is the time! Now!

reviews.title: They’re ok with 1 problem
reviews.text: I love the app But it wouldn’t give me the whole package even though I paid for a Lifetime membership. I was really disappointed that happened. Beyond that, they’re a great way to quit

reviews.title: 8 years later
reviews.text:
It's been almost 8 years now since I last smoked, and I owe a lot to this app. Seeing my progress grow still motivates me even today. 
For anyone at the beginning of their journey: you've got this. The first hours and days stretch on forever, but the years go by so quickly. 🤍

reviews.title: Best App for Quitting
reviews.text: I haven’t been a heavy smoker, but I’ve been smoking for over a decade. The app’s UI is simple and intuitive, and the daily progress tracking is motivating and helps you stay focused on your goals. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to quit.

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.text: It shows you money saved, your length of time and is great help

reviews.title: Nicotine free
reviews.text: This app follows you through out your quitting journey

reviews.title: Great Motivational App!
reviews.text: I was in my first two weeks of quitting smoking when I found Smoke Free. I wish I would have had it the last time that I quit! It is designed for cigarette smoking but you can easily add vapes if you need to. Just have to do a little math. This app has been so helpful in having a visual tracker of how many days that I had been quit and how much money I have saved. I really love it!

reviews.title: Crash crash crash
reviews.text:
This was once a really great app and I still use it, but it crashes during or after making a diary entry. It simply won’t stay open. 

UPDATE: 4/7/26: I was in contact with support. Updated app and reinstalled but that didn’t fix anything. Support still hasn’t replied to last email sent on 3/20. Very discouraging.

reviews.title: Good app
reviews.text: I enjoy the health updates it gives you. Even with the free version I feel like it is useful.

reviews.title: Helped me to stay on track!
reviews.text: This app really helped me focus on the wins of quoting verses the stress of not having a cigarette. Without this app I wouldn’t have made it this far!
